Name: Mercedes R. Lackey
Question: Since a fictional world is a representation of a possibility, are the scenarios presented (the emotions, actions and interactions of the fictional characters), true, factual and genuine within that possibility (alternative reality)?
Answer: Maybe. But you’d better give justification for your decisions to the reader or they’ll toss the book across the room and never read you again.

Name: Mercedes R. Lackey
Question: How do I protect myself from energy vampire someone astral projects onto my room and take my energy away and leave me with their filthy and defiled energy he uses my energy to shield himself?
Answer: By realizing these things are all bullshit, imaginary, and bogus and stop believing in them.

Name: Mercedes R. Lackey
Question: Why have I been seeing angel numbers like 11, 111, 1111, 1101, 1110, and 1011 everywhere and all the time, especially during this lowest phase of my life?
Answer: Because you are looking for them, expecting to see them, and forgetting all the times you see numbers that do not fit that pattern. Angel numbers are just repackaged numerology, and both are bullshit.

Name: Mercedes R. Lackey
Question: I feel having an odd job with less responsibility is better to get an art career since it is not that bad if you lose it and you have nothing to worry about when you get home. Any toughts?
Answer: You can accomplish the same thing with better pay by getting a certificate in one of the trades, like auto mechanic, HVAC, electrician, plumber.

Name: Mercedes R. Lackey
Question: Why did tattoos become more common in the 2010s? I ask because growing up in the 1990s and 2000s, hardly anyone had them. Is it because of social media?
Answer: No, it’s because of several things. Tatto parlors used to be illegal in many states, now they are not. Fashion embraced tattoos, and celebrites started getting them. And people want to proclaim how different they are now.

Name: Mercedes R. Lackey
Question: What would theoretically happen if someone tried to sneak into the Vatican secret archives and took all the books?
Answer: Yeah, good luck with that, Sparky. The Vatican Guards may look silly and ineffective to you in their fancy outfits, but they have absolute jurisdiction on Vatican grounds. You might not end up full of holes, but if you are lucky you’ll be turned in to the Rome police with only a few broken bones.

Name: Mercedes R. Lackey
Question: What happens to the law of attraction and people who suffer from catastrophic thoughts? The universe punishes these people and sends them bad situations in their lives? Energy is all
Answer: All of it, bullshit. You’re taking physics principles and applying them to magical woo. This is like frosting a cake with spackling. It doesn’t work, because the “energies” you are trying to “manipulate” simply do not exist.

Name: Mercedes R. Lackey
Question: Why are demons targeting me? There are worse sinners put there. Why do they target them?
Answer: Demons do not exist, therefore they are not targeting you. If you are having mental problems you should get professional psychiatric help.

Name: Mercedes R. Lackey
Question: My story is reminiscent of Naruto is that ok?
Answer: Everyone has to start somewhere when they start writing. My early (unpublished) stories were very reminiscent of Andre Norton. Don’t worry about it, just get on with the next story, which should be a lot less reminiscent of Naruto.

Name: Mercedes R. Lackey
Question: What are intuition and aura?
Answer: Intuition is merely the subconscious giving you a conclusion that is not obvious to your conscious mind. An aura is a halo of light around something. “Psychic auras” are, however, bullshit.

Name: Mercedes R. Lackey
Question: Why, oh why, do so many people insist that psychic abilities are real? Whats the allure?
Answer: There are two lures. The first is money. There are many people who know damn well that they are not psychic, that psychic powers are bullshit, butthey will claim psychic powers are real and that they have them in order to dupe the credulous out of their money. Some are more successful, some are less successful, but it is a reliable way to be a con artist. The other lure is that belief in psychic powers almost always is accompanied by the belief that the person has them or can in some way acquire them, thus making them special. These are generally people who have (or so they think) nothing special about them. Instead of doing the work of going out and getting some kind of tangible skill or ability that will actually make them special, they prefer to sit back and daydream about psychic powers.

Name: Mercedes R. Lackey
Question: Some games like Guitar Hero III have no sequels due to copyrights. We use touch screen phones that Apple bought the patent for. Isn't it very important to attack copyrights in order to prevent the concept of copyrights from sabotaging civilization?
Answer: If you “attack copyrights” you will never see anything new made ever again. Why should people put work into something they will never be paid for?

Name: Mercedes R. Lackey
Question: Why am I having astral projections every time I take Valium? I read many people online that they have it after taking Valium. Is there any scientific evidence that support this?
Answer: You are not having astral projections. Astral projections are not real. What you are having is a floaty, intoxicated feeling of complete relaxation and a lack of stress. This is what Valium does and what it is supposed to do. There is zero scientific evidence to support any astral projects at all.

Name: Mercedes R. Lackey
Question: Why would a group of people stand in a military cemetery and pose for pictures around a gravestone and give the thumbs up?
Answer: Because the guy giving the thumbs-up is a sociopathic bastard without a shred of empathy, and he thinks the photo is all about him, regardless of the fact that he’s standing on someone’s grave, surrounded by the graves of people he literally called “losers” because they died.

Name: Mercedes R. Lackey
Question: Why does my 3-month-old baby keep smiling at my deceased mom’s photos?
Answer: Because it’s a face. Babies at that age start smiling at faces in general, including printed images.

Name: Mercedes R. Lackey
Question: What is a collection of reflection about the life of Jessica Licaycay?
Answer: It’s a stack of printed paper enclosed between two cover pages.

Name: Mercedes R. Lackey
Question: I read about experiments by the Soviets where telepaths could instantly put the receiver to sleep. Are there advanced techniques for developing telepathy, or is it entirely related to visualizing well while in a deep meditative state?
Answer: You do know that Soviet “scientists” routinely falsified their “results” to get what their controllers wanted, don’t you? That’s especially true for “psychic powers” since there was no way to disprove them, and any time the power “failed,” they could blame it on “disbelievers in the room.” Come on, these are people who not only claimed that watering fruit trees with sugar water made the fruit sweeter, but that this “trait” was passed on to the descendants of those trees! Psychic powers are bullshit.

Name: Mercedes R. Lackey
Question: Do you know anything in the occult or esoteric about how the astrology of parents influences the child?
Answer: I know that nothing about the “astrology” of the parent ever influences the child, because astrology is bullshit, the occult in general is bullshit.

Name: Mercedes R. Lackey
Question: Is there a tree of fiction?
Answer: As in, a kind of family tree? For very early fiction—I’m talking Babylonian, Greek, Roman here—someone might have built a family tree, but after that, there is just too much to categorize.

Name: Mercedes R. Lackey
Question: Would someone with psychopathy notice it if they were possessed by a demon? Would anyone in general actually notice it when they are possessed themselves?
Answer: No one would ever notice it because possession is not real and there are no demons.

Name: Mercedes R. Lackey
Question: How do you check if you’re possessed? Is it like being in a long dream and waking up one day and wondering what the hell did I do while being executed?
Answer: Easy. You are not possessed. There are no such things as demons and spirits. What you do, if you have lost stretches of time, is see a competent psychiatric professional and be truthful with them.

Name: Mercedes R. Lackey
Question: Who is the artist who illustrated Trump's trading cards?
Answer: There isn’t one credited. My guess is they got some unpaid intern to hack them together with a combination of AI and photoshop.

Name: Mercedes R. Lackey
Question: Is the Flying Dutchman a vengeful ghost like Sadako, Kayako, and Samara?
Answer: The “Flying Dutchman” is from an opera by Wagner of the same name. The Dutchman of the title is not a vengeful ghost, it is a ship Flying Dutchman - Wikipedia

Name: Mercedes R. Lackey
Question: How can I write a solid first paragraph for a fantasy novel? I am a novice in writing so I am having a lot of trouble.
Answer: Stop trying to make the perfect first paragraph. Just start. Don’t worry about that first paragraph until you are done with the first draft. You can’t edit what isn’t on the page.

Name: Mercedes R. Lackey
Question: What does it mean to hear whispers of my name in my left ear when no one is around?
Answer: You may have a hearing disorder. Alternatively there may be something around you that is making a sound that you interpret as your name because you can’t hear it clearly.

Name: Mercedes R. Lackey
Question: What would be the benefits to society if nothing could be "intellectual property"?
Answer: You would get no one making anything new. Why bother putting any work into it when someone can just take it for free?

Name: Mercedes R. Lackey
Question: How many digits does a US mobile number have?
Answer: Ten. Just like landline numbers. The difference is that when you dial long distance from a landline number within the US you need to add “1” to the front of the number. You don’t have to do that on a mobile phone.

Name: Mercedes R. Lackey
Question: Could the cave-dwelling artists have had no sense of their self-worth, or were just plain ignorant of depicting themselves as subjects?
Answer: This “question” betrays the ignorance of the OP. Go away and research cave art for yourself, then come back and delete this.

Name: Mercedes R. Lackey
Question: Why can't my budgie chew hard? My budgie can't chew normal pellets and when she was new and used to aggressively bite me it was so lightly. And yes I know the difference between an aggressive and non-aggressive bite.
Answer: She might have a weak beak that is prone to splitting. When that happens it hurts, like a nail that is split down to the quick. Try giving her soft food like cooked veggies, and sprinkle Biotin for birds on it and see if that doesn’t help. It has a very nice taste, a little sweet, and she will probably like it.

Name: Mercedes R. Lackey
Question: My incarcerated uncle wrote several books and short stories. Where can I post one of his short stories that possible publishers or people that can assist with getting them published can read it?
Answer: Unfortunately there is a myth going around that publishers and agents are reading works self-published online in order to find new writers. This is a myth, and is completely untrue. They are already drowning in unsolicited submissions, and have no time to go surfing through self-published stuff online. If you want to help him, then the best thing you can do for him is to pick out the best of his books and get a professional editor to give it a full edit. Then he needs to revise and rewrite his book according to the professional editor’s suggestions, and this will probably take at least five or six rewrites. Once he’s done with that, you can take the next steps.

Name: Mercedes R. Lackey
Question: I am sick of trying, asking, and paying money. Is there anyone who is honest and knows how to cast out demons from a person who is under demonic oppression in Europe?
Answer: The reason why nothing is “working” is because demons do not exist. They are mythical. Imaginary. They are not a “thing.” Please seek professional psychiatric help. You clearly have a mental problem and calling it a “demon” is not going to get rid of it.

Name: Mercedes R. Lackey
Question: What was Oscar Wilde's life like?
Answer: I suggest you read a couple of biographies and find out.

Name: Mercedes R. Lackey
Question: Are there more angels or demons?
Answer: Since both are equally imaginary, the answer is the numbers are equal. Both are zero.

Name: Mercedes R. Lackey
Question: What are some reasons why it is mandated that a hero thinks of the future, especially the future generations?
Answer: It’s not “mandated.” Your story could be about a nihilistic hero who doesn’t think about the future at all, because they don’t expect to be in it.

Name: Mercedes R. Lackey
Question: Can you train animals to speak Urdu?
Answer: You can certainly train a parrot to speak Urdu, and many people have.

Name: Mercedes R. Lackey
Question: If I write a book, where can I publish it and earn money?
Answer: Your premise, that “publishing a book will earn money” is inherently flawed. Most first self-published novels earn between $0 and $500 per year. More of them earn $0 than earn $500. In fact, if you factor in that many writers end up pricing their books at $0 just to try and earn an audience, those books are losing money. Even among successful writers, most of them are earning less than minimum wage for their books, and 95% of them cannot make a living from writing alone. If you want something that makes you money from the beginning, start collecting and recycling aluminum soda cans. You’ll make more money than you will from writing a book. Writers write because they have to; because there are stories inside them trying to claw their way out.

Name: Mercedes R. Lackey
Question: Why do I have a fear of black circle censored photos of crime scenes when gore doesn't bother me? Square censorships are fine but circles make me anxious.
Answer: Please seek professional psychiatric help, not “opinions” from random fantasy writers on the internet.

Name: Mercedes R. Lackey
Question: What do you think Stephen King and Edgar Allen would do with a collaborative writing project?
Answer: I don’t think Stephen King is at all interested in Webflow design.

Name: Mercedes R. Lackey
Question: I want to sell my soul to the devil. Where do I find the devil?
Answer: Why would you think the devil would want your soul? People are giving their souls away to the devil all the time.

Name: Mercedes R. Lackey
Question: How would you summarize a technique for creating a character?
Answer: I decide the kind of person or creature that fits the needs of the skeletal story. Then I work out their character traits, good and bad, weaknesses and strengths. And most of all, I figure out what their problem is going to be, because solving that problem and having them come out the better for their struggles in the end is what makes a satisfying story.

Name: Mercedes R. Lackey
Question: Is diligence the most important or is talent?
Answer: Without talent, all the diligence in the world won’t help you create or perform something. Without the diligence to put in the practice, all the talent in the world won’t help you succeed.

Answer: Pretty much the same way they are made now. Spinning wheel plan

Preferably several professional, neutral inspectors.

Name: Mercedes R. Lackey
Question: How do we know historical events happened if we didn't have photographs or videos? What if they were just fairy tales?
Answer: Because there are multiple witnesses that can verify what happened. Often hundreds of thousands of multiple witnesses. But your question also brings up the very apt saying “History is determined by the winners.”

Name: Mercedes R. Lackey
Question: What do you know about synthetic thread/yarn?
Answer: It’s made from petrochemicals and is bad for the environment.

Name: Mercedes R. Lackey
Question: Why are many people still convinced Bob Lazar is a liar even after David Grusch came forward and testified in Congress?
Answer: Just because someone says he is a “former intelligence officer” that doesn’t mean it’s true. Sure he could have worked for intelligence organizations at some point…as a janitor. Name: Mercedes R. Lackey
Question: How can I start my candle business as an 11-year-old? I know how to make candles really well. I have a logo too.

Question: How is being the person that has what you’ve been trying to manifest going to help you achieve the thing you want to manifest?

Question: How does a book editor edit digital manuscripts (is that a dichotomy)? How are words crossed out, notes/comments added, and all the traditional marks and symbols used, which used to be done in red pencil on paper, now done on digital submissions?

Name: Mercedes R. Lackey
Question: How do the US dare to produce horror films in which children also involve in killing sprees, such as the film "Leatherface - The source of Evil"? What do parents say when their children involve in such 18 years old limited films?

Name: Mercedes R. Lackey

Answer: …..sure. You make up whatever makes you happy, Sparky. You’re just lucky there’s no law against torturing reality until it screams.

Name: Mercedes R. Lackey
Question: I heard About five knocks and it was 2 am I slept over at a friends house in the living room and got woken up by five knocks so loud and clear. What could it mean?
Answer: You were sleeping. That’s all I needed to hear. It was a dream; I can’t count the number of times I’ve been awakened by a dream of knocks, phantom doorbells, even alarm clocks.

Question: How do I fight evil correctly to defeat it?
Answer: I have a lot of problems with this idea, because what is “evil” to you might be totally harmless, or even good. LGBT, other religions, even other ways of thinking might be evil to you, but that doesn’t mean they are actually harmful. If you want to fight “evil” start by fighting it inside yourself.

Name: Mercedes R. Lackey
Question: From an esoteric perspective, who are the shadow people? Why are they here and why do they follow us?
Answer: From a rational perspective centered in reality, there are no “shadow people.”

Answer: Easy. They aren’t. Astra projection, like all other psychic powers, is bullshit.

Name: Mercedes R. Lackey
Question: Is Jeff Dunham still legally liable for not returning his borrowed book on ventriloquism to the library when he was a kid?
Answer: Technically, yes. But these days libraries tend to forgive this sort of thing, because pursuing it is more difficult and costly than forgiving it. The exception is school and university libraries, because they can hold your diploma hostage until you pay lost book or late fees, and they do.

Name: Mercedes R. Lackey
Question: I'm 72 years old. I see zero evidence of "climate change" which not too long ago was called global warming. I remember the global cooling craze of the 70s. What do young climate activists have to say about this?
Answer: I’m 74 and trained in science. I see so much evidence of climate change that it terrifies me. Everything from the seasons starting “early” to winters without snow and summers producing the hottest temperatures on record, from glaciers that have stood intact for thousands of years now melting away to nothing, to the migration of birds into places they never were before. If you can’t see it, you’re either pig-ignorant or blind.

Name: Mercedes R. Lackey
Question: How would you interpret a text from parent saying I’m checking to make sure my child is there? Would you interpret it as neglectful and be appalled that she didn’t know where her child was or that she was concerned and acting responsible?
Answer: I would not “intepret” it at all. That comes into the camp of “mind your own business.” Instead I would answer immediately and truthfully without trying to interpret it.

Name: Mercedes R. Lackey

Question: How does creative expression help strengthen one's sense of self?

Answer: There are people who claim to, but they are either frauds or delusional.

Question: Is it correct/accurate to say that the most frequent occurrence of paranormal activity happens during the 3 to 4 AM time window? If yes, what is the significance behind this if there are any?
Answer: It would be correct to say that the illusion of “paranormal activity” happens between those hours, largely because that is when people are inclined to sleep terrors.

Name: Mercedes R. Lackey
Question: How can I portray the concept of a Lich villain in my fictional book without being in violation of AD&D or Blizzard Entertainment copyright and trademarks?
Answer: AD&D did not invent the concept, nor the name, of liches. Dig out sources pre 1960 and read them, and base your lich on them.

Name: Mercedes R. Lackey
Question: Can a slaty-headed parakeet talk? If it can, how can I teach them?
Answer: All parakeets have the potential to talk, but whether they do or not depends on the individual.

Name: Mercedes R. Lackey
Question: Why can't science fiction and space opera shows have real physics and science conversations? After all The Big Bang Theory did, and shows like industry use incomprehensible finance terminology.
Answer: In books rather than visual media you generally find reliance on real physics. However there are shows like The Expanse, which is based on a book series, that do follow real science.

Name: Mercedes R. Lackey
Question: I wrote a fantasy anthology that flopped. How do I sell loads of author copies in a matter of hours?
Answer: Find a magic lamp and summon a genie to grant you a wish. Dude, I have 146 books with traditional publishers and I can’t sell “loads of author copies in a matter of hours.” Except, maybe, at a science fiction convention where I am the guest of honor. Face the facts: first novels, self-published, generally make between $0 and $500 per year. And generally the number is closer to $0 than to $500. Anthologies sell worse than that.

Name: Mercedes R. Lackey
Question: The fascinating Sobek episode of The Haunting had me wondering, has anyone else ever had an encounter with an Egyptian god?
Answer: In reality, gods do not exist. In fiction, such as The Haunting, there are a great many encounters with Egyptian gods. Possibly one of the most amusing is a 19th century ballet call The Pharoah’s Daughter. I freaking love all these “ancient Egyptians” in classical tutus.

Name: Mercedes R. Lackey
Question: Is a time machine magic?
Answer: There are no time machines in reality, but in fiction, they tend to be technology. This differs in romantic fantasy where time travel tends to happen magically, without a machine.

Name: Mercedes R. Lackey
Question: Do ‘psychic sensations’: Sensing ‘Someone’ is Near, truly exist? Had there been Scientific Studies done, on the subject?
Answer: No, they do not exist. Yes, scientific studies have been done on the subject.

Name: Mercedes R. Lackey

Question: What do you think of science fiction, or fantasy novels, that talks about how people can be very cruel, and unnice towards people who are viewed as being so different from the norm, or the majority of the society, can you give some examples?
Answer: Oh sweet summer child…. Pretty much every science fiction or fantasy novel features the protagonist as the Misunderstood and Persecuted Outsider. That’s because science fiction and fantasy readers are more often than not, themselves Misunderstood and Persecuted Outsiders.

Name: Mercedes R. Lackey
Question: How do I write a deconstructive parody?

Question: What is the process to manifesting what you want? What have you manifested, and why?
Answer: “Manifestation” is just a cute word for “wishing really, really hard.” Even Mr. Rogers knew better than that.

Question: How many people lose pet birds due to not clipping their wings?
Answer: So many, and it is so sad. Those birds rarely find safety; usually they find a terrifying, painful death.

Name: Mercedes R. Lackey
Question: We are dealing with a demon now. Every time we think it’s gone, it comes back stronger. What do we do?
Answer: This is the only real demon: Congratulations on being able to buy a $110k car! Now I don’t know why you’d want to be rid of it, but apparently it can’t quit you, and it seems in order to persuade you to keep it, it has found a hot rod tuner that is making it even more powerful than it was off the showroom floor. Question: Why do they call pretending "make-believe"?
Answer: Because you are “making” a temporary “belief.” Like, “fairies are real” or “I have a talking white horse in my back yard.” Hopefully, the belief you make is temporary and when you stop playing, you stop believing in it….

Name: Mercedes R. Lackey
Question: I want to draw a fantasy map for my story, but I can't make it geographically and meteorologically accurate. How can I fix this problem?
Answer: Why do you want to bother with drawing a map? Just don’t. Hundreds of fantasy books are published every year without maps. I almost never consult a map when I write mine—I just set the book somewhere new.

Name: Mercedes R. Lackey
Question: Would you prefer a personal book bound copy of a book you wrote or his favourite fanfic?
Answer: Neither. My books already come out in hardback and I currently have literal cartons of them taking up space in my living room. And I do not read fanfic.

Name: Mercedes R. Lackey
Question: Is Character.Al is bad?
Answer: AI is bad because it is trained using work real people did, without compensating those real people. AI is bad because it is being used to put real people out of work. I know some of those real people.

Name: Mercedes R. Lackey
Question: What did Harris know of Joe's dementia, and when did she know it?
Answer: People bandy the word “dementia” around a lot. Dementia is a measurable mental condition. It often involves halucinations. Joe Biden does not have it. My mother in law, rest her, had it. I know exactly what it looks like. It looks nothing like anything Joe Biden does. What Joe Biden has is plain old age. The older you get, the easier it is to get worn out. The older you get, the harder it is to remember things—as in, things that would come instantly to you now take five or ten minutes to remember. The older you get, the more time you need to make a decision. That’s what my late father looked like, and that’s what Joe Biden looks like. Short form, in my opinion, Joe just “couldn’t keep up.” He understands exactly what is going on, but he can’t react to it anymore as fast as he used to. And in today’s political climate, if you can’t react fast, you’d better get out of the way and let those who can take over. Which is what he did. And if he had had dementia, he never would have stepped aside, because people with dementia have no idea that they aren’t as fast as they used to be.

Name: Mercedes R. Lackey
Question: Are demons real? Ever since I was younger I felt like I could hear and see certain things that make me think that demons are real or maybe ghost and right now im in my room feeling scared because its happening again
Answer: This is the only demon that is real. It will not fit in your room, but you are right to be concerned about it because a lot of people who buy expensive, fast muscle cars like this one are raging jerks and don’t pay any attention to where they are going because they think everyone else should get out of their way. Evils spirits, ghosts and “demons” don’t exist. If they did, every country in the world would weaponize them, and there would be demons raging through Gaza and armies of demons fighting each other on the Russian Front in the Ukraine. Since you don’t see that, it means demons (and magic, and ghosts) don’t exist.

Question: What is the difference between digital rights management and a paywall?
Answer: DRM prevents you from copying something you bought, like a book, song, or movie. A paywall prevents you from seeing something until you pay for it, like a news article or a video online, or the Paris Olympics.

Name: Mercedes R. Lackey
Question: Is it possible to believe in paranormal things like having a dream of something and it happening at the right moment?
Answer: It’s possible to believe in such things, but you’re not believing in reality if you do.

Name: Mercedes R. Lackey
Question: Is there a serious chance that advanced AI technology may displace or make obsolete creative or “image industries” such as artists, actors, and modeling (etc.) or will there always be a need for real humans in these professions? Why or why not?
Answer: If there were not a serious chance that AI could replace actors and models, actors would not be fighting tooth and nail to protect their physical image so that their clones can be used in future movies and TV series without pay. This is a very real and serious concern. The image of Carrie Fisher has been used twice now, the first time was a little creepy, but the second actually worked. As for artists, pretty much every artist I know has lost work to AI. Instead of commissioning book covers for indie books, something that used to pay the bills for people I personally know, the authors have been using AI to generate covers—and now get this “In the style of ArtistX”—and they get that cover, which was created by ripping off that very same artist, by using their work without paying a cent to train the AI. Writing is more complicated…but if AI can be trained on the work of an artist, it can be trained on the work of a writer.

Name: Mercedes R. Lackey
Question: Can a modern-day author be as successful at being an essayist, as authors using other styles of writing? Or, is a collection of essays a style that has seen its time, and is no longer lucrative nor popular?
Answer: Unless you are a very popular public figure, no one wants to read essays. Even then, most people won’t want to read your essays. And I hate to burst your bubble but 97.5% of all writers cannot make a living at writing. Most writers make less than minimum wage from their writing. So given that parameter, the number of people that could publish a lucrative or popular collection of essays can be counted on one hand, and all of them are already famous.

Name: Mercedes R. Lackey
Question: How can a person get the quality of deity he's worshipping?
Answer: Make sure you get a good warrantee on that deity, and have a thorough inspection by a deity expert before you commit to your purchase.
